parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client to ensure that different requests have unique ClientToken values. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. The default value is empty. The description must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), but cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: Ipv6TranslatorId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. The default value is the instance ID. The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), but cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the **DescribeRegions** operation to query region IDs.
